text: いま　さいこうに　ツイてる　はず！

structure.jp: さいこうに　ツイてる　はず！
structure.en: I should be at my luckiest!

patterns.name: 〜はずだ
patterns.explanation: はず after a statement means the speaker is fairly sure it must be so. ツイてる　はず = 'I should be lucky'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb shows the state someone is in now; here it is shortened to てる, as in casual speech. ツイてる = 'am in luck'.
